clue.text: A golfer practising sleight-of hand?

definitions.meaning: Arnold ... was a famous American golfer
a conjuror who palms a card hides it in the hand, so one doing so is described by the answer

explanation.surface: A golfer who is secretly a card sharp on the side.
explanation.definitionFit: Arnold Palmer won many major golf titles; and a card cheat who palms cards is one who conceals them by sleight of hand.

clue.text: An older man makes an excellent personal assistant

parts.note: grand means splendid or excellent

explanation.surface: A retired gentleman proves a superb secretary.
explanation.definitionFit: A grandfather is an older man, a generation above the parents.

clue.text: Most are to swap accommodation on board

indicators.note: to swap is to exchange places, so these letters change their positions

explanation.surface: Most people are willing to trade cabins on a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: A stateroom is a private cabin on a ship, i.e. sleeping quarters aboard.

clue.text: Deferential, so may get landed in 21 down

indicators.note: landed is placed inside the answer to the clue 21 down

parts.note: the answer to 21 down is the American writer Poe
lit means alighted or landed, as a bird lit on a branch

explanation.surface: Being respectful may get you put down inside another clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Courteous and respectful behaviour is deferential.

clue.text: Even though without money, a bite may be obtained

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the rearranged letters sit around money
the letters of a bite are taken as material from which a new arrangement may be obtained

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for pounds sterling, from Latin libra

explanation.surface: You can still get something to eat even though you have no cash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may be obtained' rearranges A BITE into ABEIT, and 'without' (meaning outside) puts it round L.
explanation.definitionFit: Albeit is a conjunction meaning although.

clue.text: Deny Ben misbehaved in a foot ball crowd

indicators.note: the jumbled name goes inside the other pieces, within the crowd

parts.note: the gate is the number of spectators at a football match

indicators.note: the letters of Ben behave badly, getting out of their proper order

explanation.surface: Someone denies that Ben behaved badly among the football fans.
explanation.walkthrough: 'misbehaved' turns BEN into BNE, which 'in' puts between A and GATE. The odd split 'foot ball' hides the British sense of gate, a match attendance.
explanation.definitionFit: To abnegate is to renounce or refuse, so to deny oneself something.

clue.text: Dim-sighted animal carrying a learner

indicators.note: the animal holds the learner within it, as if carrying it

parts.note: a bear is a large animal
L is the learner sign on a British car

explanation.surface: A creature with poor eyesight bears a novice on its back.
explanation.definitionFit: Blear eyes are bleary, watery and unable to see clearly.

clue.text: He aims to be both popular and caring

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
tender means kind and caring

explanation.surface: A man who wants to be well liked and kind as well.
explanation.definitionFit: One who intends something has an aim or purpose; the agent noun names a person with intentions.

clue.text: Putting gas in, for a time turned it on

parts.note: an era is a period of time

indicators.note: the two words it on are turned around into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone switched on a gas supply for a while.
explanation.definitionFit: Aeration is the process of charging a liquid or soil with air or another gas.

clue.text: Six-footers in groups

parts.note: sects are religious or political groups or factions

explanation.surface: Tall people form into factions.
explanation.definitionFit: Insects have six legs, so they are six-footed creatures.

clue.text: A cleric finding what a computer can do

parts.note: DD, Doctor of Divinity, is a degree held by clergymen

explanation.surface: A clergyman discovers what his computer is capable of.
explanation.definitionFit: Computers perform arithmetic, so summing numbers is something they do.

clue.text: Passed on alcoholic liquor discovered in the long grass

indicators.note: the liquor is found inside the grass

parts.note: a reed is a tall grass growing in water
port is a fortified wine

explanation.surface: Someone told of drink found hidden in the tall grass.
explanation.definitionFit: To have passed on information is to have relayed or told it.

clue.text: Assuage irascibility

definitions.meaning: a quickness to anger, a bad mood

explanation.definitionFit: To moderate something is to soften or assuage it; a quick, hot disposition is an angry mood.

clue.text: Uncertain, or sure one is wrong

indicators.note: these letters are in an uncertain, unsettled order and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: Doubt sets in: one can be confident and still be mistaken.
explanation.definitionFit: Something mistaken or incorrect is wrong.

clue.text: All are bad."Gilbert (Ruddigore)

parts.note: a quotation with a word missing from the Gilbert and Sullivan opera Ruddigore, whose cursed titled gentlemen of the Murgatroyd family must commit a crime every day

explanation.surface: A line from Gilbert's Ruddigore with a gap to fill.
explanation.walkthrough: The full line is 'All baronets are bad' from Ruddigore, a comic opera by Gilbert and Sullivan; the missing word fills the gap.
explanation.definitionFit: In Ruddigore the hereditary title holders of Ruddigore are cursed to be wicked, hence the line.

clue.text: Not all of the elderly enjoy modern poetry

indicators.note: only some of the letters of the word modern are used, a run from its middle

explanation.surface: Older people do not all like contemporary verse.
explanation.definitionFit: An ode is a lyric poem, so it is a piece of poetry.

clue.text: Mark is indeed drawn

indicators.note: the word indeed is read as in deed, putting mark inside the deed

parts.note: a deed is a legal document
a sign is a mark or symbol

explanation.surface: The mark really is sketched.
explanation.walkthrough: The setter treats 'indeed' as the two words 'in deed', a common crossword trick, so the container indicator is hidden inside a single word.
explanation.definitionFit: A plan that has been drawn up has been designed, sketched out on paper.

clue.text: Woman needs man-right?

parts.note: he is the pronoun for a man

explanation.surface: A woman needs a man who is just right.
explanation.definitionFit: The pronoun is used for a woman, so in crosswords it stands for a female person.

clue.text: Pressed to include a married lady

indicators.note: pressed holds the other pieces inside it

parts.note: made means forced or pressed, as in made someone go

explanation.surface: Someone was pushed into including a wife.
explanation.definitionFit: Madame is the French title for a married woman, used in English for a lady.

clue.text: A writer taking exercise-there's nothing in that

indicators.note: nothing is put inside exercise

parts.note: PE is physical education, school exercise
O is the figure zero, nothing

explanation.surface: An author doing exercise finds it pointless.
explanation.definitionFit: Edgar Allan Poe was an American author of stories and poems.

clue.text: Manual worker backing the French soft drink

parts.note: a miner is a labourer who works with his hands underground

indicators.note: the French article is read from right to left, going backwards

parts.note: la is the French feminine word for the

explanation.surface: A labourer supports French fizzy drinks.
explanation.definitionFit: In Britain a mineral is a fizzy non-alcoholic drink, from mineral water.

clue.text: Being against work at the riverside, give voice

parts.note: op, short for opus, is a musical work
the Po is the river of northern Italy
to sing is to give voice in song

explanation.surface: A singer by the river performs in protest.
explanation.definitionFit: To be opposing is to be resisting or contrary to something.

clue.text: Speak earnestly but quietly about a church

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical direction for quietly
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: Talk with conviction but softly about a church.
explanation.definitionFit: To deliver a sermon is to speak with moral earnestness.

clue.text: Gain the impression 19 across is after a gun

indicators.note: the answer to 19 across comes after the gun

parts.note: gat is slang for a gun
the answer to 19 across, the woman's pronoun

explanation.surface: Get the feeling that a woman is chasing a gunman.
explanation.definitionFit: To infer or understand something is to get the impression of it.

clue.text: New or ancient repository

indicators.note: the letters take a new form, being rearranged

explanation.surface: A store for either new or old items.
explanation.definitionFit: A receptacle that holds things is a repository.

clue.text: Some people getting escorted out colour

indicators.note: only some of the letters of these words are used, a run spanning them

explanation.surface: People who are taken out for the evening colour up.
explanation.definitionFit: A tinge is a slight colour or shade.

clue.text: Employ an unknown character to cut tree back

indicators.note: the letter cuts into the reversed tree, sitting inside it
back here means in the reverse direction, so tree is read from its last letter to its first

parts.note: X is the unknown in algebra

explanation.surface: Use an unidentified person to prune a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: To exert force is to bring it to bear, to employ it.

clue.text: Lion-hearted, though for ages kept in line

indicators.note: the ages are held inside the line

parts.note: taken as written
an eon is a vast period, ages

explanation.surface: Brave, though made to stay in a queue for ages.
explanation.definitionFit: Leonine means like a lion, hence brave and lion-like.

clue.text: Nice article about a minister

parts.note: a is the indefinite article
C, circa, means about
a curate is an assistant member of the clergy

explanation.surface: A pleasant newspaper piece about a vicar.
explanation.definitionFit: Nice in its old sense means precise or exact.

clue.text: The coastal resort doesn't change

indicators.note: the letters are changed into a different order

explanation.surface: The seaside town never alters.
explanation.walkthrough: OSTEND is a Belgian port and seaside resort.
explanation.definitionFit: Ostend is a seaside town on the Belgian coast.
